content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduates in B.Com/ B.Sc./ B.A./BBA/BBS (with minimum 60% marks) from the recognized University Experience: Desirable: One year experience in administrative works; Knowledge in Computer and Typing; Experience in Office clerical works Age limit: Within 21-45 years (as on the date of the interview) Age relaxation: SC 5 years, ST 5 years, Women 5 years, OBC 3 years Other conditions: Furnish declaration as detailed in Annexure-I and Annexure-II duly signed Desirable: One year experience in administrative works Knowledge in Computer and Typing Experience in Office clerical works

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement

content_sections.text: Shortlisting (shortlisted candidates intimated by email) Walk-in interview Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email Only those who receive communication may appear for the walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Bio-data in Annexure-I format with passport size photograph Attested copies of experience proof Signed declarations in Annexure-I and Annexure-II No Objection Certificate from present employer, if any One valid ID proof at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application format in Annexure-I and the declaration in Annexure-II, duly signed. Send bio-data with scanned copies of original supporting documents to [email protected] on or before 25-11-2026. Send all original certificates from matriculation onwards in scanned form to the same email. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email and only they may appear for the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates with a near or distant relative employed at ICAR-CMFRI must declare it in Annexure-II before the interview date No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview The total number of vacancies may vary depending on other requirements on the date of interview Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification or termination The decision of the Director, ICAR-CMFRI will be final and binding in all respects

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-CMFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is within 21-45 years (as on the date of the interview). Relaxation: SC 5 years, ST 5 years, Women 5 years, OBC 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30000 consolidated emoluments as per revised ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduates in B.Com/ B.Sc./ B.A./BBA/BBS (with minimum 60% marks) from the recognized University.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Furnish declaration as detailed in Annexure-I and Annexure-II duly signed.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants who do not send original certificates from matriculation onwards in scanned form will not be allowed to appear for interview. A candidate who declares a relative at ICAR/CMFRI only on the date of interview will not be interviewed.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting (shortlisted candidates intimated by email). Walk-in interview. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email. Only those who receive communication may appear for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on a contract basis for a period of one year from the date of joining. No claim for regular appointment; positions are purely contractual, non-regular, time-bound. Competent authority has the right to terminate without assigning any reason at any time.
